implementation: Refactored executable local-grid and preprocessing logic; these files are not represented as the original executed scripts.
archived_grid: Previously executed reference comparison, not rerun for this submission.
optional_execution: The same declared candidates, fold pooling and ranking, evaluated only at the three accepted final estimator seeds; historical grid scores are evidence and are not claimed to be the output of this optional final-seed rerun.

current_IL10_release.selection: Family and imputer jointly selected by highest three-realisation mean pooled OOF R2 across all 20 locked configurations.
current_IL10_release.panel_selection: Accepted trio selected after C4 case-error ranking; C4 is selection-informed.

historical_scope: historical_local_grid.csv, grid_original_checkpoint_comparisons.csv and controlled_grid_* retain the pre-crosslink-revision dataset/configuration scope. Their IL10 rows do not describe the revised release. final_seed_all20_comparisons.csv and final_family_benchmarks.csv contain the current accepted models for both targets.
